title: Natural finite affine frames for tensor-section sheaves
statement: Let p be prime, S a quasi-compact locally Noetherian scheme over F_p [def-pc-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth], and E a finite locally free O_S-module [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module]. For every small-etale U over S and x in U, there is an affine open neighbourhood A of x in U, a natural number n, and for every etale V over A an additive equivalence between sections of the universe-lifted tensor-section sheaf [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] on V and Γ(V,O_V)^n. The equivalences commute with every etale restriction and with multiplication by each section of O_V.

proof.text: Use the existing preservation of finite local freeness under module pullback. Choose a finite free trivialization of the pullback of E on an open B of U containing x, refine B to an affine open A, and reindex its finite basis by ULift (Fin n). Pull this isomorphism to every etale V over A using the modules pseudofunctor and pullHom. The construction uses the abstract module pullback and does not need the separate tensor-section adjunction wrapper.

Transport the pulled-back free frame to tensor sections through tensorSectionsPullbackComparison. Evaluation from etaleHom of the unit is surjective: a section determines the homomorphism sending 1 to that section. Evaluation naturality and pullHom composition reduce coordinate naturality to the existing theorem that finite free coordinates commute with pullback through a factorization. Compose the resulting linear coordinates with the additive ULift equivalence and reindex ULift (Fin n) by Fin n. Linearity proves scalar compatibility, including rank zero.

proof_origin.note: Implemented from existing finite-local-freeness, abstract pullback, tensor comparison, evaluation naturality and finite free coordinate naturality APIs. Transparent local lets share the existing scalar action so kernel conversion does not unfold tensor pullback.

theorem frobenius_vectorBundle_local_frames
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (S : Scheme.{u})
    [S.Over (Spec (.of (ULift.{u} (ZMod p))))] [CompactSpace S] [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
    (E : S.Modules) [E.IsFiniteLocallyFree] :
    ∀ (U : S.Etale) (x : U.left),
      ∃ (A : U.left.Opens) (_ : IsAffineOpen A), x ∈ A ∧
      ∃ n : ℕ,
      let f : A.toScheme ⟶ S := A.ι ≫ U.hom
      let M : A.toScheme.Etale ⥤ S.Etale :=
        MorphismProperty.Over.map (Y := S) ⊤
          (inferInstance : Etale f)
      let L := Etale.localizationRestriction (U := S) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        f inferInstance
      let G := (sheafCompose S.smallEtaleTopology
        AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).obj (Modules.etaleTensorSectionsSheaf E)
      let act (V : A.toScheme.Etale) (b : Γ(V.left, ⊤))
          (s : (Modules.etaleTensorSectionsSheaf E).obj.obj (op (M.obj V))) :=
        (@id Γ((M.obj V).left, ⊤) b) •
          (@id Γ((Modules.tensorPullback (M.obj V).hom).obj E, ⊤) s)
      ∃ e : ∀ V : A.toScheme.Etale,
          (L.obj G).obj.obj (op V) ≃+ (Fin n → Γ(V.left, ⊤)),
        (∀ (V W : A.toScheme.Etale) (g : W ⟶ V) (s : (L.obj G).obj.obj (op V)),
          ∀ i, e W ((L.obj G).obj.map g.op s) i = g.left.appTop (e V s i)) ∧
        (∀ (V : A.toScheme.Etale) (a : Γ(V.left, ⊤))
          (s : (L.obj G).obj.obj (op V)),
          e V (ULift.up (act V a s.down)) =
                a • e V s)
